headword: {静脈瘤|じょうみゃくりゅう}

definitions.explanation: Veins that have become swollen and twisted, most often in the legs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{静脈瘤|じょうみゃくりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I've developed varicose veins in my legs.

examples.japanese: {立|た}ち{仕事|しごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{静脈瘤|じょうみゃくりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: People who work on their feet are prone to varicose veins.

examples.japanese: {下肢|かし}{静脈瘤|じょうみゃくりゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる→命に関わる：15467_inochinikakawaru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だるさや⟦むくみ→むくみ：07277_mukumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Varicose veins in the legs are rarely life-threatening, but they make the legs heavy and swollen.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{静脈|じょうみゃく}→静脈：05858_joumyaku⟧ (vein) + {瘤|りゅう} (swelling).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下肢|かし}{静脈瘤|じょうみゃくりゅう}: varicose veins of the legs (the usual medical name)
- {食道|しょくどう}{静脈瘤|じょうみゃくりゅう}: esophageal varices

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse it with ⟦{動脈瘤|どうみゃくりゅう}→動脈瘤：31537_doumyakuryuu⟧ (aneurysm), a swelling in an artery, which is far more dangerous.
